title: Subconscious permit gates foreground writes
summary: Foreground agents should no longer treat direct task graph claims as their public authority. Subconscious becomes the external control interface: it sets up or selects the DAG task anchor, wiring, worktree, branch and judge path internally, then issues a scoped execution permit. The write gate should validate that permit for the current session/agent/path; the underlying task graph remains the durable internal substrate and audit trail.
